frames_source: tools.m3_foot render work/p0001 (seed 20260827, 50 of 3987 positioned player detections)
convention: Ground position is the point midway between where the two feet touch the ground; with one foot down it is the point under that foot; with neither down it is the point under the hips. dx is positive to the right, dy positive downward, both in source pixels, both measured from the drawn crosshair at the box bottom centre.
what_was_judged: Each detection was rendered at 8x with the detection box drawn on it and a
grid in source pixels, labelled every 4 px, spanning +/-16 px around the
assumed foot point. The offset was read off the grid rather than estimated.
The grid started at +/-10 px and had to be widened to +/-16: a box drawn
tight round a running body puts its bottom centre several pixels away from a
mid-stride foot, further than the first grid could show.
caveats: These are the agent's own readings, not an independent human's.
Reading noise is roughly +/-1.5 px per sample on a clean crop and worse on
the seven marked LOW CONFIDENCE, where a player in front, a pylon or a
painted line makes the feet ambiguous. Over 50 samples that noise averages
down in the mean but inflates the rms and the p95, so the spread reported is
One sample (f205 #12) is CENSORED: the detection box ends at the player's
mid-back, so the true foot is below the grid entirely. It is recorded at the
floor of 16 px, which makes the reported maximum a lower bound rather than a
measurement. It is left in rather than dropped, because dropping the worst
case is how an error budget comes out flattering.
